aigp_8gates_final.zip.name: 8-Gate Racer
aigp_8gates_final.zip.description: Specialized 8-gate racer starting from 5-gate base. Optimized for aggressive banking (120° roll limit) and progressive gate rewards.

aigp_racer_final.zip.name: Swift Racer (100M Extended)
aigp_racer_final.zip.description: Extended training of Swift baseline to 100M steps. Highly tuned for maximum performance.

aigp_distill_final.zip.name: Vision Policy (Distilled)
aigp_distill_final.zip.description: CNN-based vision policy with FPV + simulated event camera. Trained via distillation from state experts. Suitable for sim-to-real transfer.

state_based.example:
from stable_baselines3 import PPO
model = PPO.load('aigp_8gates_final.zip')
obs, _ = env.reset()
action, _ = model.predict(obs, deterministic=True)

vision_based.example:
model = PPO.load('aigp_distill_final.zip')
env = DroneRaceEnv(vision_mode=True)
obs, _ = env.reset()
action, _ = model.predict(obs, deterministic=True)
vision_based.note: Requires vision_mode=True. Observation is Dict with 'image' and 'state' keys

sim_to_real.recommendation: Use aigp_distill_final.zip for actual drone deployment
steps: 1. Test on real drone in safe environment
2. Fine-tune with domain randomization for hardware variations
3. Use MuJoCo rendering config to match real camera
